leadText: Volume 7 is the seventh volume of the Pokémon Diamond and Pearl Adventure! manga created by 伊原しげかつ Shigekatsu Ihara.
plainText:
Volume 7 is the seventh volume of the Pokémon Diamond and Pearl Adventure! manga created by 伊原しげかつ Shigekatsu Ihara.

==Publications==
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

==Chapters==
Chapter 1: Look For Giratina!
Chapter 2: A Clash! Hareta vs. Charon
Chapter 3: The Anger of Legendary Pokémon Heatran
Chapter 4: Hareta's Excellent New Partner...Minun?!
Chapter 5: Charon Must Be Stopped!
Special Chapter: Return to Hareta's Home Forest!

==Important events==
Jupiter and Mars leave Team Galactic to search for Cyrus.
Hareta and Mitsumi follow Team Galactic to Stark Mountain, where they meet Charon.
The Egg given to Hareta by Kaisei hatches into a .
B-2 joins Hareta's group as they go to take down Charon and Neo Team Galactic.

==Party changes==
===Additions===
The following Pokémon are obtained:
Hareta's Minun in DPA30

==Character summary==
===Hareta's party===
 

===Mitsumi's party===
 

==Trivia==
 
Looker, who was erroneously named "Hansom" (an unusual romanization of his Japanese name, "Handsome") in volume six, is referred to as "Looker" beginning in The Anger of Legendary Pokémon Heatran. He explains that "Looker" is his code name and he is referred to as "Looker" ever since then.
